(추가적으로 민감도분석을 진행한? 선행연구들이 섬유막의 범위를 어떻게 선정하였고, 그 논리를 같이 살펴보면서 마무리한다) --- # Contents --- - Ex - vivo test - In - vivo test - FEM simulation result and map the root source of the material property. - Linear elastic - Neo - Hookean - MOONEY - mMOONEY - HGO - etc. - Draw the graph from the last FEM simulations with various Material Model # 1. (Ex-Vivo) Experiment --- ### 1.1 Holzapfel et al. 2005 --- **"Determination of layer-specific mechanical properties of human coronary arteries with nonatherosclerotic intimal thickening and related constitutive modeling"** DOI: [https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16006541/](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16006541/) Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1152/ajpheart.00934.2004](https://doi.org/10.1152/ajpheart.00934.2004) - **혈관**: Human **coronary** arteries — 13개 `nonstenotic `LAD (유일한 관상동맥 직접 실험!) - **실험 방법**: Layer separation (adventitia / media / intima) 후 **uniaxial tension** in circumferential & longitudinal directions. Extended HGO model (ρ-dispersion formulation) fitting. - **시편**: 71.5 ± 7.3세, nonatherosclerotic intimal thickening (frank atherosclerotic fibrous cap 아님) - **결과**: Intima — μ = 27.90 ± 10.59 kPa, k₁ = 263.66 ± 490.95 kPa, k₂ = 170.88 ± 125.47, φ ≈ 18.8° - **특이사항**: (1) **유일한 관상동맥 layer-specific 실험 데이터** — 이 분야에서 coronary라고 할 수 있는 실험은 이것뿐. (2) 하지만 시편이 **비죽상경화 내막비후(nonatherosclerotic intimal thickening)** 조직이라 실제 atherosclerotic fibrous cap과는 다름 — collagen architecture, cellular composition, lipid infiltration 등이 다를 수 있음. (3) k₁의 SD가 평균보다 큼 (490.95 vs 263.66) — 시편 간 collagen 구조 variability가 극도로 큼. (4) HGO 모델의 높은 k₂(170.88) 때문에 λ ≈ 1.05 이상에서 급격한 strain-stiffening — 이로 인해 low strain에서 E ≈ 167 kPa, high strain에서 E \> 1,000 kPa로 문헌의 soft/stiff 범위를 자연스럽게 bridge. → 추후 HGO 기반 FEM 논문들이 이 파라미터를 직접 채택: Cilla et al. 2012, Cardoso et al. 2014 (HGO 비교 시)
Layer μ (kPa) k₁ (kPa) k₂ (–) φ (°)
**Intima** **27.90 ± 10.59** **263.66 ± 490.95** **170.88 ± 125.47** **\~18.8**
Media 1.27 ± 0.63 21.60 ± 7.12 8.21 ± 3.27 \~37.8
Adventitia 7.56 ± 4.66 38.57 ± 25.51 85.03 ± 50.00 \~58.9
### 1.2. Kural & Billiar 2012 --- **"Planar biaxial characterization of diseased human coronary and carotid arteries for computational modeling"** DOI: [https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22169152/](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22169152/) Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbiomech.2011.11.019](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbiomech.2011.11.019) - **혈관**: Human **coronary** arteries (diseased) — 유일한 diseased coronary 직접 biaxial 실험 - **실험 방법**: Planar biaxial tensile testing — circumferential + longitudinal 동시 loading. Anisotropic modified Mooney-Rivlin model fitting. - **시편**: `Diseased coronary artery wall` (예: Specimen Cor-5). Whole-wall 테스트 — fibrous cap만 분리한 것이 아님. - **결과**: Anisotropic mod. Mooney-Rivlin: c₁ = −1,312.9 kPa, D₁ = 629.7 kPa, D₂ = 2.0, c₂ = 114.7 kPa, K₁ = 35.9 kPa, K₂ = 23.5. Biaxial stiffness: circ mean = 1,631 kPa, axial = 938 kPa at max equibiaxial stress. - **특이사항**: (1) **유일한 diseased coronary biaxial 데이터** — coronary + atherosclerotic + biaxial 조합은 이 논문뿐. (2) 음수 c₁(−1,312.9)은 exponential term이 지배적일 때 전형적인 fitting artifact — 물리적으로 음의 ground-state stiffness를 의미하지 않음. (3) **Whole-wall** 테스트이므로 fibrous cap만의 물성이 아닌 media+adventitia 포함된 복합 응답. (4) Isotropic uniaxial curve로 직접 플롯 불가 — fiber anisotropy term (K₁, K₂)이 있어 방향별로 다름. → 추후 FEM논문에서 diseased coronary의 anisotropic 물성 참고로 사용 ### 1.3. Holzapfel et al. 2004 (J Biomech Eng) --- **"Determination of constitutive equations for human atherosclerotic plaques"** (iliac) DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1839184](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1839184) - **혈관**: Human **iliac** artery atherosclerotic plaques (관상동맥 아님) - **실험 방법**: Uniaxial tensile testing to failure — circumferential & axial 방향. Layer separation 후 fibrous cap, media, adventitia 각각 테스트. - **시편**: Atherosclerotic iliac artery에서 분리한 fibrous cap layer - **결과**: Fibrous cap **ultimate stress 254.8 ± 79.8 kPa at stretch λ = 1.18 ± 0.10** (circumferential), axial 470 ± 100 kPa - **특이사항**: (1) **Fibrous cap을 layer로 분리하여 직접 인장시험**한 몇 안 되는 연구 중 하나. (2) 다만 **iliac artery** — 관상동맥과 혈관 크기, 벽 두께, 혈역학 환경이 상이. (3) Ultimate stress 데이터이므로 파단 기준(failure criterion)으로 활용 가능 — 300\~545 kPa 범위. (4) 이 논문의 constitutive fitting은 Ogden model 기반. → 추후 FEM논문에서 fibrous cap failure criterion 설정에 사용됨 ### 1.4. Karimi et al. 2013 --- **"Measurement of the uniaxial mechanical properties of healthy and atherosclerotic human coronary arteries"** DOI: [https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23628400/](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23628400/) Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.msec.2013.01.065](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.msec.2013.01.065) - **혈관**: Human **coronary** arteries — 14 healthy + 8 atherosclerotic (부검 5시간 이내) - **실험 방법**: Ex vivo uniaxial tensile testing — whole-wall (layer separation 없음) - **시편**: 22개 관상동맥 (14 healthy, 8 atherosclerotic), 부검 후 5시간 이내 테스트 - **결과**: Healthy E = 1,515 kPa (avg 1,480–1,550), Atherosclerotic E = 4,150 kPa (avg 3,770–4,530) - **특이사항**: (1) **관상동맥 직접 인장시험** — coronary 실험 데이터. (2) **Whole-wall** 테스트이므로 fibrous cap만의 물성이 아닌 전체 벽 응답. (3) Atherosclerotic wall이 healthy보다 \~2.7배 stiff — calcification과 fibrosis에 의한 경화. (4) Tangent modulus at physiological stress 기준이라 small-strain E와 직접 비교 시 주의 필요. → Atherosclerotic coronary wall E=4,150 kPa는 다른 연구들의 fibrous cap E=500\~1,000 kPa보다 훨씬 높음 — whole-wall vs layer-specific 차이 # 2. (In - Vivo) Experiment --- ## B. IVUS Inverse FEM (Coronary) — Tang Group ### 4. Guo & Tang 2017 **"A patient-specific carotid plaque progression simulation using a meshless method"** DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1007/s10237-016-0820-3](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10237-016-0820-3) - **혈관**: Human **coronary** arteries (in vivo IVUS) - **방법**: IVUS-based inverse FEM — IVUS 영상에서 혈압 하 변형을 측정하고 inverse method로 물성 역산 - **모델**: Modified Mooney-Rivlin: W = c₁(I₁-3) + D₁\[exp(D₂(I₁-3)) - 1\] - **결과**:Median FC: **c₁ = 27.0 kPa, D₁ = 10.57 kPa, D₂ = 2.0**Stiff FC: **c₁ = 90.0 kPa, D₁ = 35.2 kPa, D₂ = 2.0** - - - **환자**: Coronary patients - **특이사항**: (1) **In-vivo에서 hyperelastic (MMR) 파라미터를 직접 역산**한 연구. (2) D₂ = 2.0으로 ex-vivo (Teng 2014의 D₂=18.2) 대비 매우 작음 — strain-stiffening이 약함. (3) Median과 Stiff 두 가지 카테고리 제시. → Teng 2015 sensitivity analysis에서도 이 데이터 활용 ### 5. Wang/Tang et al. 2021 **"Patient-specific wall stress analysis in coronary arteries using IVUS-based FEM"** DOI: [https://doi.org/10.3389/fphys.2021.721195](https://doi.org/10.3389/fphys.2021.721195) - **혈관**: Human **coronary** arteries (in vivo IVUS) - **방법**: IVUS inverse FEM — 혈압 변화에 따른 IVUS 단면 변형으로 물성 역산 - **모델**: Anisotropic Mooney-Rivlin - **결과**: Circumferential YM = **1,043 kPa** (range 103–2,317 kPa); **in-vivo가 ex-vivo 대비 36% softer** - **환자**: 13 patients, 20 plaque slices - **특이사항**: (1) **In-vivo vs ex-vivo 물성 차이를 정량적으로 보고**한 핵심 연구 — ex-vivo 시편의 수축/고정 아티팩트로 인해 in-vivo보다 stiff. (2) Anisotropic model 사용. (3) 범위가 103–2,317 kPa로 매우 넓음 — plaque heterogeneity 반영. ### 6. Wang/Tang et al. 2023 **"Correlations between morphological features and mechanical properties of coronary plaques"** DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijcard.2022.09.051](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijcard.2022.09.051) - **혈관**: Human **coronary** arteries (in vivo IVUS) - **방법**: IVUS inverse FEM — 2021 연구의 확장 - **모델**: Mooney-Rivlin - **결과**: Morphology–stiffness 상관관계 분석 (lipid core 크기, FC 두께 등과 물성의 관계) - **환자**: 19 patients, 32 cross-sections - **특이사항**: (1) 2021 연구의 코호트 확장. (2) **FC 두께가 얇을수록, lipid core가 클수록 물성 변동이 큼** — Teng 2015 sensitivity 결과와 일치. ## B. MRI-Based Inverse FEM (Carotid) — Tang Group ### 4. Liu/Tang et al. 2012 **"Quantifying patient-specific in vivo coronary plaque material properties for accurate stress/strain calculations"** DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1115/1.4005685](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.4005685) - **혈관**: Human **carotid** arteries (in vivo MRI) - **방법**: MRI-based inverse FEM — multi-contrast MRI에서 혈압 하 변형을 추출하고 물성 역산 - **모델**: Modified Mooney-Rivlin - **결과**: Effective YM = **137–1,435 kPa, 평균 479 kPa** - **환자**: 12 carotid patients - **특이사항**: (1) **MRI 기반 in-vivo 물성 추정의 대표적 연구**. (2) 환자 간 편차가 \~10배 (137 vs 1,435 kPa). (3) 경동맥이므로 관상동맥과 직접 비교에 주의. ### 8. Wang/Tang et al. 2017 **"Patient-specific carotid plaque progression simulation using 3D meshless generalized finite difference method"** DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0180829](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0180829) - **혈관**: Human **carotid** arteries (in vivo MRI, 18개월 추적) - **방법**: MRI-based inverse FEM — 18개월 간격 MRI로 plaque progression에 따른 물성 변화 추적 - **모델**: Modified Mooney-Rivlin - **결과**: YM = **70–1,284 kPa, 평균 411 kPa**; 단일 혈관 내에서도 **311% 편차** - **환자**: 8 carotid patients (18-month follow-up) - **특이사항**: (1) **시간에 따른 plaque 물성 변화**를 추적한 유일한 연구. (2) 단일 혈관 내에서도 311% 편차 — plaque의 공간적 heterogeneity가 극도로 큼. (3) 경동맥 조직. ### 9. Franquet et al. 2013 **"A new method for the in vivo identification of mechanical properties in arteries from cine MRI images"** DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmbbm.2013.03.001](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmbbm.2013.03.001) - **혈관**: Human **carotid** arteries (in vivo MRI) - **방법**: MRI + Kalman filter inverse method — cine MRI에서 벽 운동을 추출하고 Kalman filter로 물성 식별 - **모델**: Hyperelastic (Gent model) - **결과**: Fibrous tissue shear modulus **\~300–500 kPa** - **환자**: 8 carotid patients - **특이사항**: (1) **Kalman filter 기반 실시간 물성 식별** — 기존 inverse FEM 대비 계산 효율 높음. (2) Gent model 사용 (Neo-Hookean + strain-limiting). (3) 경동맥 조직. "}

# Dense Calcification Papers to Read
아래 4편만 먼저 읽으면 `calcification itself`의 direct bulk stiffness와 coronary FEM adopted value를 빠르게 잡을 수 있다.
## 1. Cahalane et al. (2018)
- DOI: [10.1016/j.actbio.2018.09.010](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.actbio.2018.09.010)
- Why read: human carotid plaque의 dense calcification을 microCT radiodensity와 nanoindentation으로 직접 연결한 핵심 논문.
- Working takeaway: dense calcification stiffness band를 대략 `17-25 GPa`로 잡는 근거.
## 2. Cahalane et al. (2020)
- DOI: [10.1007/s11340-020-00635-z](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11340-020-00635-z)
- Why read: 2018 결과를 symptom-linked ex vivo plaque context에서 다시 볼 수 있는 후속 논문.
- Working takeaway: representative dense-calcification anchor를 약 `22.4 GPa` 수준으로 보는 데 유용.
## 3. Ebenstein et al. (2009)
- DOI: [10.1088/0031-9155/54/21/003](https://doi.org/10.1088/0031-9155/54/21/003)
- Why read: carotid plaque 내 partial calcification과 bulk calcification을 nanoindentation으로 구분해서 보여주는 초기 direct paper.
- Working takeaway: bulk calcification은 direct measurement이지만 dense-calcification upper band보다는 낮은 쪽 anchor로 해석 가능.
## 4. Milzi et al. (2021)
- DOI: [10.7554/eLife.64020](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.64020)
- Why read: coronary OCT-FEM에서 calcification material property를 실제 modeling에 어떻게 채택했는지 바로 확인 가능.
- Working takeaway: coronary adopted value로 `10 GPa`를 쓰는 modern reference로 보기 좋음.
## `5. Barrett et al. (2019)`
`→ Review paper (핵심 문헌 무조건 참고해야함)`
- DOI: 10.1161/ATVBAHA.119.312017
- Why read: 죽상판의 미세/거대 석회화의 기계적 의미를 정리한 review로, 문헌 전반에서 `isolated calcification particles`의 Young's modulus가 GPa대까지 올라간다는 점을 요약한다.
- Working takeaway: dense mineral-like calcification을 모델링할 때 `~0.7–21 GPa` 수준의 literature band를 뒷받침하는 review anchor로 유용하다.
## 6. Cahalane et al. (2020)
- DOI: 10.1007/s11340-020-00635-z
- Why read: human plaque calcification의 radiodensity와 stiffness를 symptom-linked ex vivo context에서 다시 정리한 후속 연구.
- Working takeaway: representative dense calcification anchor를 약 `22.4 GPa` 수준으로 둘 때 후속 근거로 인용하기 좋다.
## 7. Ebenstein et al. (2009)
- DOI: 10.1088/0031-9155/54/21/003
- Why read: carotid plaque 내에서 partial calcification과 bulk calcification을 nanoindentation으로 구분해 제시한 초기 direct-measurement 논문.
- Working takeaway: 완전 mineralized dense calcium보다 낮은 쪽 anchor도 존재함을 보여주므로, `1–25 GPa` 범위를 제시할 때 lower-to-upper band 논리를 보강하는 데 유용하다.

- Why read: 죽상판의 미세/거대 석회화의 기계적 의미를 정리한 review로, 문헌 전반에서 `isolated calcification particles`의 Young's modulus가 GPa대까지 올라간다는 점을 요약한다.
- Working takeaway: dense mineral-like calcification을 모델링할 때 `~0.7–21 GPa` 수준의 literature band를 뒷받침하는 review anchor로 유용하다.
## 6. Cahalane et al. (2020)
- DOI: 10.1007/s11340-020-00635-z
- Why read: human plaque calcification의 radiodensity와 stiffness를 symptom-linked ex vivo context에서 다시 정리한 후속 연구.
- Working takeaway: representative dense calcification anchor를 약 `22.4 GPa` 수준으로 둘 때 후속 근거로 인용하기 좋다.
## 7. Ebenstein et al. (2009)
- DOI: 10.1088/0031-9155/54/21/003
- Why read: carotid plaque 내에서 partial calcification과 bulk calcification을 nanoindentation으로 구분해 제시한 초기 direct-measurement 논문.
- Working takeaway: 완전 mineralized dense calcium보다 낮은 쪽 anchor도 존재함을 보여주므로, `1–25 GPa` 범위를 제시할 때 lower-to-upper band 논리를 보강하는 데 유용하다.

<content>
# Goal
---
문헌들에서 사용한 Lipid Core material property를 정리하고, 각 FEM 논문이 사용한 `E_lipid` 혹은 관련 constitutive parameter가 어떤 root source에서 왔는지 추적하여 민감도 분석용 물성 범위를 해석할 수 있게 한다.
# Contents
---
- Experiment data / root-source papers
- FEM simulation papers using lipid-core material assumptions
- Correction / caution notes embedded in each paper entry
# 1. Experiment data
---
### 1.1 Loree et al. 1994 
---
**"Mechanical Properties of Model Atherosclerotic Lesion Lipid Pools"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1161/01.ATV.14.2.230](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.ATV.14.2.230)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1161/01.ATV.14.2.230](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.ATV.14.2.230)
- **혈관**: N/A - synthetic lipid mixtures
- **실험 방법**: Dynamic shear rheology of model lipid pools
- **시편**: Cholesterol monohydrate + phospholipids + triglycerides synthetic mixtures
- **결과**: `G* = 0.05-0.3 kPa`, incompressible conversion 기준 `E ≈ 0.15-0.9 kPa`
- **특이사항**: 
	- (1) soft lipid mechanical basis로 자주 언급되는 대표 실험. 
	- (2) 실제 조직이 아니라 synthetic lipid model이라는 점은 반드시 구분해야 함. 
	- (3) Akyildiz 2011 같은 later FEM paper가 very soft necrotic core의 근거로 직접 연결하는 대표 source.
### ~~1.2 Lee et al. 1991~~
---
**~~"Hypocellular fibrous cap dynamic compression study"~~**
~~DOI: ~~[~~https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.83.5.1764~~](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.83.5.1764)
~~Full text: ~~[~~https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.83.5.1764~~](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.83.5.1764)
- **~~혈관**: Human aortic plaque tissue~~
- **~~실험 방법**: Dynamic compression / viscoelastic characterization~~
- **~~시편**: 11 caps, including 5 hypocellular caps~~
- **~~결과**: 약 ~~~~`41 kPa`~~~~ at 0.01 Hz~~
- **~~특이사항**: (1) 이것은 pure lipid core가 아니라 **hypocellular fibrous cap** 데이터. (2) lipid core 물성으로 miscite되는 경우가 있으므로 본문에서는 caution source로 취급해야 함. (3) 최종 coronary lipid-core range를 직접 정당화하는 원천값으로 쓰기에는 부적절.~~
### 1.3 Chai et al. 2013
---
**"Micro-indentation and inverse FEM study of carotid plaque components"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbiomech.2013.03.017](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbiomech.2013.03.017)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbiomech.2013.03.017](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbiomech.2013.03.017)
- **혈관**: Human carotid plaque
- **실험 방법**: Micro-indentation + inverse FEM, Neo-Hookean interpretation
- **시편**: Carotid endarterectomy samples
- **결과**: 전체 조직 분포의 median 약 `30 kPa`, overall range `6-891 kPa`; lipid pool은 가장 soft한 쪽에 위치
- **특이사항**: (1) component-specific single lipid value를 직접 주는 논문은 아니고, plaque component 분포 안에서 lipid pool이 soft end라는 점이 중요함. (2) carotid 기반이라 coronary direct value로 그대로 옮기기는 조심해야 함.
### 1.4 Teng et al. 2014
---
**"Material properties of components in human carotid atherosclerotic plaques: A uniaxial extension study"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.actbio.2014.09.001](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.actbio.2014.09.001)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.actbio.2014.09.001](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.actbio.2014.09.001)
- **혈관**: Human carotid plaque
- **실험 방법**: Ex vivo uniaxial extension with modified Mooney-Rivlin fitting
- **시편**: 38 lipid strips from 11 carotid endarterectomy samples
- **결과**: `c1 = 0.046 kPa`, `D1 = 4.885 kPa`, `D2 = 5.426`; incremental `E = 104.4 kPa (λ=1), 220.7 kPa (λ=1.1), 533.4 kPa (λ=1.15)`
- **특이사항**: (1) lipid tissue에 대해 experimentally fitted된 modified Mooney-Rivlin set으로서는 가장 직접적인 source. (2) 다만 dissected carotid strip이므로 in-situ semi-liquid coronary necrotic core보다 훨씬 stiff하게 보일 수 있음. (3) Tang group parameter와 성격이 전혀 다르므로 같은 레벨로 해석하면 안 됨.
### 1.5 Rezvani-Sharif et al. 2019
---
**"Human coronary lipid core AFM study"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmbbm.2019.04.056](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmbbm.2019.04.056)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmbbm.2019.04.056](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmbbm.2019.04.056)
- **혈관**: Human coronary plaque
- **실험 방법**: AFM indentation with Hertz-model interpretation
- **시편**: Human coronary cadaveric samples, about 7-10 cases
- **결과**: `E = 2.7 ± 1.8 kPa`
- **특이사항**: (1) human coronary-specific lipid-core direct measurement로 가장 중요한 anchor 중 하나. (2) FEM literature의 1-10 kPa range와 비교할 때, 실제 coronary direct data가 low-kPa order임을 보여줌.
### 1.6 Savvopoulos et al. 2024
---
**"Porcine coronary lipid-rich region AFM study"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1098/rsif.2023.0674](https://doi.org/10.1098/rsif.2023.0674)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1098/rsif.2023.0674](https://doi.org/10.1098/rsif.2023.0674)
- **혈관**: Porcine coronary plaque-like lesion
- **실험 방법**: AFM indentation with Hertz-model interpretation
- **시편**: D374Y-PCSK9 minipig coronary lipid-rich region
- **결과**: median `E = 2.2 kPa`
- **특이사항**: (1) animal model이지만 coronary lipid-rich region의 low-kPa stiffness를 지지함. (2) human coronary direct value는 아니므로 Rezvani-Sharif 2019보다 보조 근거로 보는 것이 적절함.
# 2. FEM simulation
---
### 2.1 Cheng et al. 1993
---
**"Distribution of circumferential stress in ruptured and stable atherosclerotic lesions. A structural analysis with histopathological correlation"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.87.4.1179](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.87.4.1179)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.87.4.1179](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.87.4.1179)
- **혈관**: Human coronary plaques
- **실험 방법**: Histology-based computational structural analysis / linear elastic FEM assumption
- **시편**: 24 histology-based coronary lesions modeled computationally
- **결과**: lipid pool를 매우 soft한 `E = 1 kPa`, `ν = 0.49`로 가정
- **특이사항**: (1) coronary plaque FEM에서 `1 kPa` soft-core lineage의 earliest anchor. (2) 이후 Huang 2001, Williamson 2003, Milzi 2021 계열이 이 흐름을 이어감.
### 2.2 Huang et al. 2001
---
**"The Impact of Calcification on the Biomechanical Stability of Atherosclerotic Plaques"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.103.8.1051](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.103.8.1051)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.103.8.1051](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.103.8.1051)
- **혈관**: Human coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: FEM structural analysis with calcification effects
- **시편**: Computational plaque models
- **결과**: lipid core에 `E = 1 kPa`, `ν = 0.49`
- **특이사항**: (1) Cheng 1993의 1 kPa assumption을 그대로 이어받은 논문. (2) calcification effect를 보려는 목적이므로 lipid stiffness 자체를 새로 측정하거나 재정의한 것은 아님.
### 2.3 Williamson et al. 2003
---
**"On the Sensitivity of Wall Stresses in Diseased Arteries to Variable Material Properties"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1537736](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1537736)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1537736](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1537736)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: Sensitivity analysis with isotropic / nonlinear / transversely isotropic material assumptions
- **시편**: Computational diseased artery models
- **결과**: lipid core baseline `E = 1 kPa`, with `±50%` variation around initial values
- **특이사항**: (1) immediate citation chain은 Cheng 1993 + Loree 1994. (2) 하지만 1 kPa 자체는 여전히 Cheng lineage의 assumption으로 보는 것이 적절함. (3) later Ohayon 2008이 이 논문을 immediate source로 사용.
### 2.4 Finet et al. 2004
---
**"Biomechanical interaction between cap thickness, lipid core composition and blood pressure in vulnerable coronary plaque: impact on stability or instability"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1097/00019501-200402000-00003](https://doi.org/10.1097/00019501-200402000-00003)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1097/00019501-200402000-00003](https://doi.org/10.1097/00019501-200402000-00003)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: Parametric FEM study of cap thickness, lipid composition, and pressure
- **시편**: 414 computational simulations
- **결과**: baseline `E_lipid = 10 kPa`, parametric range 5\~400kPa
- **특이사항**: 
	- (1) widely reused `10 kPa` baseline의 핵심 source.
	- (2) Cheng의 `1 kPa`와는 다른 lineage로 보는 것이 맞음. 
	- (3) Le Floc'h 2009와 일부 later FEM paper의 10 kPa 계열이 여기서 출발.
	- (4) E lipid 증가할수록 Peak cap stress 감소.
### ~~2.5 Baldewsing et al. 2004~~
---
**~~"Finite element modeling and intravascular ultrasound elastography of vulnerable plaques: parameter variation"~~**
~~DOI: ~~[~~https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ultras.2003.11.017~~](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ultras.2003.11.017)
~~Full text: ~~[~~https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ultras.2003.11.017~~](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ultras.2003.11.017)
- **~~혈관**: Coronary plaque model~~
- **~~실험 방법**: IVUS elastography-oriented FEM parameter study~~
- **~~시편**: Computational IVUS plaque models~~
- **~~결과**: lipid stiffness range ~~~~`6.25-400 kPa`~~
- **~~특이사항**: (1) representative single value를 제안한 논문이 아니라 parameter sweep 자체가 목적. (2) 따라서 root source는 특정 historical value가 아니라 이 논문 자체의 parametric design으로 봐야 함.~~
### 2.6 Vengrenyuk et al. 2006
---
**"A hypothesis for vulnerable plaque rupture due to stress-induced debonding around cellular microcalcifications in thin fibrous caps"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.0606310103](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.0606310103)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.0606310103](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.0606310103)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: Microcalcification hypothesis with computational stress analysis
- **시편**: Computational thin-cap plaque models
- **결과**: `lipid_core.md`에는 `E = 5 kPa`로 정리되어 있음
- **특이사항**: (1) 현재 로컬 정리 기준으로는 이 `5 kPa`를 원문에서 clean하게 재확인하지 못했음. (2) 따라서 이 엔트리는 `uncertain value`로 표시하는 것이 안전함. (3) 계보상으로는 Cheng / Finet 계열 discussion 위에 놓여 있으나, 독립적인 root source로 취급하면 안 됨.
### 2.7 Ohayon et al. 2008
---
**"Necrotic core thickness and positive arterial remodeling index: emergent biomechanical factors for evaluating the risk of plaque rupture"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1152/ajpheart.00005.2008](https://doi.org/10.1152/ajpheart.00005.2008)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1152/ajpheart.00005.2008](https://doi.org/10.1152/ajpheart.00005.2008)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: Parametric biomechanical FEM study of necrotic core thickness and remodeling
- **시편**: Computational plaque models
- **결과**: 로컬 correction 기준 실제 paper text는 necrotic core를 `E = 1 kPa`, `ν = 0.49`로 사용
- **특이사항**: (1) `lipid_core.md`의 `10 kPa` 정리는 correction이 필요함. (2) immediate source는 Williamson 2003. (3) root lineage는 Cheng 1993의 1 kPa soft-core assumption으로 보는 것이 맞음.
### 2.8 Le Floc'h et al. 2009
---
**"Vulnerable Atherosclerotic Plaque Elasticity Reconstruction Based on a Segmentation-Driven Optimization Procedure Using Strain Measurements: Theoretical Framework"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2009.2012852](https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2009.2012852)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2009.2012852](https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2009.2012852)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque / IVUS-based framework
- **실험 방법**: Segmentation-driven optimization and modulography / IVUS-based elasticity reconstruction
- **시편**: In vivo-inspired computational plaque framework
- **결과**: lipid core `E = 10 kPa`, `ν = 0.49`
- **특이사항**: (1) 10 kPa baseline을 사용하는 대표 later study. (2) root source는 Finet 2004로 해석하는 것이 가장 자연스러움.
### 2.9 Tang et al. 2004
---
**"Effect of a Lipid Pool on Stress/Strain Distributions in Stenotic Arteries: 3-D Fluid-Structure Interactions (FSI) Models"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1762898](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1762898)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1762898](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1762898)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: 3D FSI modeling with modified Mooney-Rivlin formulation
- **시편**: Computational stenotic artery models
- **결과**: lipid pool parameter set `c1 = 0.5 kPa`, `D1 = 0.5 kPa`, `D2 = 1.5`
- **특이사항**: (1) Tang-type modified Mooney-Rivlin lipid parameter의 first appearance. (2) Cheng 1993, Loree 1994를 background로 참조하지만 이 parameter set 자체는 실험값이 아니라 Tang group assumption임.
### 2.10 Akyildiz et al. 2011
---
**"Effects of intima stiffness and plaque morphology on peak cap stress"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1186/1475-925X-10-25](https://doi.org/10.1186/1475-925X-10-25)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1186/1475-925X-10-25](https://doi.org/10.1186/1475-925X-10-25)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: FEM study with Neo-Hookean constitutive assumptions
- **시편**: Computational plaque models
- **결과**: necrotic core `E = 1 kPa`, equivalent `C10 = 0.167 kPa`
- **특이사항**: (1) Loree 1994를 very soft core의 근거로 가장 직접적으로 재사용하는 later FEM paper. (2) Neo-Hookean form으로 옮겨갔지만 soft-core 해석은 여전히 low-kPa order를 유지함.
### 2.11 Tang et al. 2009
---
**"Sites of Rupture in Human Atherosclerotic Carotid Plaques Are Associated With High Structural Stresses"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1161/STROKEAHA.109.558676](https://doi.org/10.1161/STROKEAHA.109.558676)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1161/STROKEAHA.109.558676](https://doi.org/10.1161/STROKEAHA.109.558676)
- **혈관**: Carotid plaque, later often discussed with coronary modeling literature
- **실험 방법**: MRI-based FSI computational analysis
- **시편**: In vivo MRI-derived carotid plaque models
- **결과**: updated Tang lipid parameter set `c1 = 2.0 kPa`, `D1 = 2.0 kPa`, `D2 = 1.5`
- **특이사항**: (1) Tang 2004보다 stiffer한 updated assumption set. (2) 이 값은 실험 root가 아니라 Tang-group의 later modeling update임.
### 2.12 Kelly-Arnold et al. 2013
---
**"Revised microcalcification hypothesis for fibrous cap rupture in human coronary arteries"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1308814110](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1308814110)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1308814110](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1308814110)
- **혈관**: Human coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: High-resolution microcalcification-based computational stress analysis
- **시편**: Computational coronary cap models informed by imaging
- **결과**: lipid core `E = 5 kPa`
- **특이사항**: (1) immediate sources는 Ohayon 2008과 Akyildiz 2011. (2) 그러나 5 kPa 자체가 original experimental root는 아니며, later modeling choice로 보는 것이 적절함. (3) deeper background는 Cheng 1993 / Loree 1994 계열에 닿아 있음.
### 2.13 Cilla et al. 2012
---
**"3D computational parametric analysis of eccentric atheroma plaque: influence of axial and circumferential residual stresses"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1007/s10237-011-0369-0](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10237-011-0369-0)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1007/s10237-011-0369-0](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10237-011-0369-0)
- **혈관**: Iliac plaque model
- **실험 방법**: 3D computational parametric analysis with modified Mooney-Rivlin material law
- **시편**: 100 idealized computational plaque models
- **결과**: lipid parameter set `c1 = 0.5 kPa`, `D1 = 0.5 kPa`, `D2 = 0.5`
- **특이사항**: (1) Tang 2004 / Tang 2009 / Finet 2004 계열 literature를 참조하지만, 최종 parameter set은 paper-specific modification. (2) 특히 `D2 = 0.5`는 Tang set과 구분되는 논문 고유 선택.
### 2.14 Milzi et al. 2021
---
**"Coronary plaque composition influences biomechanical stress and predicts plaque rupture in a morpho-mechanic OCT analysis"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.64020](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.64020)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.64020](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.64020)
- **혈관**: Human coronary plaque
- **실험 방법**: OCT-based morpho-mechanic FEM analysis
- **시편**: 60-patient clinical OCT cohort; biomechanical analysis on selected ruptured/non-ruptured lesions
- **결과**: Table 2에서 necrotic lipid core `E = 1 kPa`, `ν = 0.48`
- **특이사항**: (1) paper는 literature bundle에서 값을 가져오지만, 1 kPa 자체는 Cheng lineage로 읽는 것이 자연스럽다. (2) modern OCT-FEM paper임에도 여전히 very soft 1 kPa assumption을 채택했다는 점이 중요함.
### 2.15 Corti/Cardoso et al. 2022
---
**"The effect of plaque morphology, material composition and microcalcifications on the risk of cap rupture: A structural analysis of vulnerable atherosclerotic plaques"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.3389/fcvm.2022.1019917](https://doi.org/10.3389/fcvm.2022.1019917)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.3389/fcvm.2022.1019917](https://doi.org/10.3389/fcvm.2022.1019917)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: Structural FEM analysis of morphology, composition, and microcalcifications
- **시편**: Computational vulnerable plaque models
- **결과**: lipid core `E = 5, 25, 50 kPa`; validation에서 `15, 35 kPa`도 사용
- **특이사항**: (1) earlier FEM literature를 기반으로 하지만, 이 discrete set은 paper-specific parametric design으로 보는 것이 맞다. (2) single root source에서 그대로 가져온 값 묶음은 아님.
### **`2.16 Perez et al. 2023`**
---
**"Coronary artery properties in atherosclerosis: A deep learning predictive model"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.3389/fphys.2023.1162436](https://doi.org/10.3389/fphys.2023.1162436)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.3389/fphys.2023.1162436](https://doi.org/10.3389/fphys.2023.1162436)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: FEM + ANN surrogate modeling
- **시편**: 300 log-spaced computational training cases
- **결과**: equivalent `E = 1-100 kPa`, Neo-Hookean `C10 = 0.167-16.67 kPa`
- **특이사항**: (1) 이 논문은 하나의 root physical value를 채택한 것이 아니라 broad parametric training range를 사용함. (2) Akyildiz 2011과 earlier FEM literature를 이어받아 ANN surrogate space를 구성한 경우로 해석하는 것이 맞음.
# 3. Short synthesis
---
- `1 kPa` lineage: Cheng 1993 -\> Huang 2001 / Williamson 2003 -\> Ohayon 2008 correction / Milzi 2021
- soft experimental basis: Loree 1994, and coronary direct low-kPa support from Rezvani-Sharif 2019 and Savvopoulos 2024
- `10 kPa` lineage: Finet 2004 -\> Le Floc'h 2009
- `5 kPa` lineage: later modeling choice branch, but not a single clean experimental root
- Tang/Teng branch: Tang 2004 and Tang 2009 are modeling assumptions; Teng 2014 is the direct experimental modified Mooney-Rivlin fit
- caution: Lee 1991 is hypocellular fibrous cap, not pure lipid core; Vengrenyuk 2006 value should be treated as uncertain under the current local-only evidence set
</content>

{"title":"Material Property - Lipid Core"}
</properties>
<content>
# Goal
---
문헌들에서 사용한 Lipid Core material property를 정리하고, 각 FEM 논문이 사용한 `E_lipid` 혹은 관련 constitutive parameter가 어떤 root source에서 왔는지 추적하여 민감도 분석용 물성 범위를 해석할 수 있게 한다.
# Contents
---
- Experiment data / root-source papers
- FEM simulation papers using lipid-core material assumptions
- Correction / caution notes embedded in each paper entry
# 1. Experiment data
---
### 1.1 Loree et al. 1994 
---
**"Mechanical Properties of Model Atherosclerotic Lesion Lipid Pools"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1161/01.ATV.14.2.230](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.ATV.14.2.230)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1161/01.ATV.14.2.230](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.ATV.14.2.230)
- **혈관**: N/A - synthetic lipid mixtures
- **실험 방법**: Dynamic shear rheology of model lipid pools
- **시편**: Cholesterol monohydrate + phospholipids + triglycerides synthetic mixtures
- **결과**: `G* = 0.05-0.3 kPa`, incompressible conversion 기준 `E ≈ 0.15-0.9 kPa`
- **특이사항**: 
	- (1) soft lipid mechanical basis로 자주 언급되는 대표 실험. 
	- (2) 실제 조직이 아니라 synthetic lipid model이라는 점은 반드시 구분해야 함. 
	- (3) Akyildiz 2011 같은 later FEM paper가 very soft necrotic core의 근거로 직접 연결하는 대표 source.
### ~~1.2 Lee et al. 1991~~
---
**~~"Hypocellular fibrous cap dynamic compression study"~~**
~~DOI: ~~[~~https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.83.5.1764~~](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.83.5.1764)
~~Full text: ~~[~~https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.83.5.1764~~](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.83.5.1764)
- **~~혈관**: Human aortic plaque tissue~~
- **~~실험 방법**: Dynamic compression / viscoelastic characterization~~
- **~~시편**: 11 caps, including 5 hypocellular caps~~
- **~~결과**: 약 ~~~~`41 kPa`~~~~ at 0.01 Hz~~
- **~~특이사항**: (1) 이것은 pure lipid core가 아니라 **hypocellular fibrous cap** 데이터. (2) lipid core 물성으로 miscite되는 경우가 있으므로 본문에서는 caution source로 취급해야 함. (3) 최종 coronary lipid-core range를 직접 정당화하는 원천값으로 쓰기에는 부적절.~~
### 1.3 Chai et al. 2013
---
**"Micro-indentation and inverse FEM study of carotid plaque components"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbiomech.2013.03.017](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbiomech.2013.03.017)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbiomech.2013.03.017](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbiomech.2013.03.017)
- **혈관**: Human carotid plaque
- **실험 방법**: Micro-indentation + inverse FEM, Neo-Hookean interpretation
- **시편**: Carotid endarterectomy samples
- **결과**: 전체 조직 분포의 median 약 `30 kPa`, overall range `6-891 kPa`; lipid pool은 가장 soft한 쪽에 위치
- **특이사항**: (1) component-specific single lipid value를 직접 주는 논문은 아니고, plaque component 분포 안에서 lipid pool이 soft end라는 점이 중요함. (2) carotid 기반이라 coronary direct value로 그대로 옮기기는 조심해야 함.
### 1.4 Teng et al. 2014
---
**"Material properties of components in human carotid atherosclerotic plaques: A uniaxial extension study"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.actbio.2014.09.001](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.actbio.2014.09.001)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.actbio.2014.09.001](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.actbio.2014.09.001)
- **혈관**: Human carotid plaque
- **실험 방법**: Ex vivo uniaxial extension with modified Mooney-Rivlin fitting
- **시편**: 38 lipid strips from 11 carotid endarterectomy samples
- **결과**: `c1 = 0.046 kPa`, `D1 = 4.885 kPa`, `D2 = 5.426`; incremental `E = 104.4 kPa (λ=1), 220.7 kPa (λ=1.1), 533.4 kPa (λ=1.15)`
- **특이사항**: (1) lipid tissue에 대해 experimentally fitted된 modified Mooney-Rivlin set으로서는 가장 직접적인 source. (2) 다만 dissected carotid strip이므로 in-situ semi-liquid coronary necrotic core보다 훨씬 stiff하게 보일 수 있음. (3) Tang group parameter와 성격이 전혀 다르므로 같은 레벨로 해석하면 안 됨.
### 1.5 Rezvani-Sharif et al. 2019
---
**"Human coronary lipid core AFM study"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmbbm.2019.04.056](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmbbm.2019.04.056)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmbbm.2019.04.056](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmbbm.2019.04.056)
- **혈관**: Human coronary plaque
- **실험 방법**: AFM indentation with Hertz-model interpretation
- **시편**: Human coronary cadaveric samples, about 7-10 cases
- **결과**: `E = 2.7 ± 1.8 kPa`
- **특이사항**: (1) human coronary-specific lipid-core direct measurement로 가장 중요한 anchor 중 하나. (2) FEM literature의 1-10 kPa range와 비교할 때, 실제 coronary direct data가 low-kPa order임을 보여줌.
### 1.6 Savvopoulos et al. 2024
---
**"Porcine coronary lipid-rich region AFM study"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1098/rsif.2023.0674](https://doi.org/10.1098/rsif.2023.0674)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1098/rsif.2023.0674](https://doi.org/10.1098/rsif.2023.0674)
- **혈관**: Porcine coronary plaque-like lesion
- **실험 방법**: AFM indentation with Hertz-model interpretation
- **시편**: D374Y-PCSK9 minipig coronary lipid-rich region
- **결과**: median `E = 2.2 kPa`
- **특이사항**: (1) animal model이지만 coronary lipid-rich region의 low-kPa stiffness를 지지함. (2) human coronary direct value는 아니므로 Rezvani-Sharif 2019보다 보조 근거로 보는 것이 적절함.
# 2. FEM simulation
---
### 2.1 Cheng et al. 1993
---
**"Distribution of circumferential stress in ruptured and stable atherosclerotic lesions. A structural analysis with histopathological correlation"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.87.4.1179](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.87.4.1179)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.87.4.1179](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.87.4.1179)
- **혈관**: Human coronary plaques
- **실험 방법**: Histology-based computational structural analysis / linear elastic FEM assumption
- **시편**: 24 histology-based coronary lesions modeled computationally
- **결과**: lipid pool를 매우 soft한 `E = 1 kPa`, `ν = 0.49`로 가정
- **특이사항**: (1) coronary plaque FEM에서 `1 kPa` soft-core lineage의 earliest anchor. (2) 이후 Huang 2001, Williamson 2003, Milzi 2021 계열이 이 흐름을 이어감.
### 2.2 Huang et al. 2001
---
**"The Impact of Calcification on the Biomechanical Stability of Atherosclerotic Plaques"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.103.8.1051](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.103.8.1051)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.103.8.1051](https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.103.8.1051)
- **혈관**: Human coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: FEM structural analysis with calcification effects
- **시편**: Computational plaque models
- **결과**: lipid core에 `E = 1 kPa`, `ν = 0.49`
- **특이사항**: (1) Cheng 1993의 1 kPa assumption을 그대로 이어받은 논문. (2) calcification effect를 보려는 목적이므로 lipid stiffness 자체를 새로 측정하거나 재정의한 것은 아님.
### 2.3 Williamson et al. 2003
---
**"On the Sensitivity of Wall Stresses in Diseased Arteries to Variable Material Properties"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1537736](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1537736)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1537736](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1537736)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: Sensitivity analysis with isotropic / nonlinear / transversely isotropic material assumptions
- **시편**: Computational diseased artery models
- **결과**: lipid core baseline `E = 1 kPa`, with `±50%` variation around initial values
- **특이사항**: (1) immediate citation chain은 Cheng 1993 + Loree 1994. (2) 하지만 1 kPa 자체는 여전히 Cheng lineage의 assumption으로 보는 것이 적절함. (3) later Ohayon 2008이 이 논문을 immediate source로 사용.
### 2.4 Finet et al. 2004
---
**"Biomechanical interaction between cap thickness, lipid core composition and blood pressure in vulnerable coronary plaque: impact on stability or instability"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1097/00019501-200402000-00003](https://doi.org/10.1097/00019501-200402000-00003)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1097/00019501-200402000-00003](https://doi.org/10.1097/00019501-200402000-00003)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: Parametric FEM study of cap thickness, lipid composition, and pressure
- **시편**: 414 computational simulations
- **결과**: baseline `E_lipid = 10 kPa`, parametric range 5\~400kPa
- **특이사항**: 
	- (1) widely reused `10 kPa` baseline의 핵심 source.
	- (2) Cheng의 `1 kPa`와는 다른 lineage로 보는 것이 맞음. 
	- (3) Le Floc'h 2009와 일부 later FEM paper의 10 kPa 계열이 여기서 출발.
	- (4) E lipid 증가할수록 Peak cap stress 감소.
### ~~2.5 Baldewsing et al. 2004~~
---
**~~"Finite element modeling and intravascular ultrasound elastography of vulnerable plaques: parameter variation"~~**
~~DOI: ~~[~~https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ultras.2003.11.017~~](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ultras.2003.11.017)
~~Full text: ~~[~~https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ultras.2003.11.017~~](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ultras.2003.11.017)
- **~~혈관**: Coronary plaque model~~
- **~~실험 방법**: IVUS elastography-oriented FEM parameter study~~
- **~~시편**: Computational IVUS plaque models~~
- **~~결과**: lipid stiffness range ~~~~`6.25-400 kPa`~~
- **~~특이사항**: (1) representative single value를 제안한 논문이 아니라 parameter sweep 자체가 목적. (2) 따라서 root source는 특정 historical value가 아니라 이 논문 자체의 parametric design으로 봐야 함.~~
### 2.6 Vengrenyuk et al. 2006
---
**"A hypothesis for vulnerable plaque rupture due to stress-induced debonding around cellular microcalcifications in thin fibrous caps"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.0606310103](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.0606310103)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.0606310103](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.0606310103)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: Microcalcification hypothesis with computational stress analysis
- **시편**: Computational thin-cap plaque models
- **결과**: `lipid_core.md`에는 `E = 5 kPa`로 정리되어 있음
- **특이사항**: (1) 현재 로컬 정리 기준으로는 이 `5 kPa`를 원문에서 clean하게 재확인하지 못했음. (2) 따라서 이 엔트리는 `uncertain value`로 표시하는 것이 안전함. (3) 계보상으로는 Cheng / Finet 계열 discussion 위에 놓여 있으나, 독립적인 root source로 취급하면 안 됨.
### 2.7 Ohayon et al. 2008
---
**"Necrotic core thickness and positive arterial remodeling index: emergent biomechanical factors for evaluating the risk of plaque rupture"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1152/ajpheart.00005.2008](https://doi.org/10.1152/ajpheart.00005.2008)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1152/ajpheart.00005.2008](https://doi.org/10.1152/ajpheart.00005.2008)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: Parametric biomechanical FEM study of necrotic core thickness and remodeling
- **시편**: Computational plaque models
- **결과**: 로컬 correction 기준 실제 paper text는 necrotic core를 `E = 1 kPa`, `ν = 0.49`로 사용
- **특이사항**: (1) `lipid_core.md`의 `10 kPa` 정리는 correction이 필요함. (2) immediate source는 Williamson 2003. (3) root lineage는 Cheng 1993의 1 kPa soft-core assumption으로 보는 것이 맞음.
### 2.8 Le Floc'h et al. 2009
---
**"Vulnerable Atherosclerotic Plaque Elasticity Reconstruction Based on a Segmentation-Driven Optimization Procedure Using Strain Measurements: Theoretical Framework"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2009.2012852](https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2009.2012852)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2009.2012852](https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2009.2012852)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque / IVUS-based framework
- **실험 방법**: Segmentation-driven optimization and modulography / IVUS-based elasticity reconstruction
- **시편**: In vivo-inspired computational plaque framework
- **결과**: lipid core `E = 10 kPa`, `ν = 0.49`
- **특이사항**: (1) 10 kPa baseline을 사용하는 대표 later study. (2) root source는 Finet 2004로 해석하는 것이 가장 자연스러움.
### 2.9 Tang et al. 2004
---
**"Effect of a Lipid Pool on Stress/Strain Distributions in Stenotic Arteries: 3-D Fluid-Structure Interactions (FSI) Models"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1762898](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1762898)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1762898](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.1762898)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: 3D FSI modeling with modified Mooney-Rivlin formulation
- **시편**: Computational stenotic artery models
- **결과**: lipid pool parameter set `c1 = 0.5 kPa`, `D1 = 0.5 kPa`, `D2 = 1.5`
- **특이사항**: (1) Tang-type modified Mooney-Rivlin lipid parameter의 first appearance. (2) Cheng 1993, Loree 1994를 background로 참조하지만 이 parameter set 자체는 실험값이 아니라 Tang group assumption임.
### 2.10 Akyildiz et al. 2011
---
**"Effects of intima stiffness and plaque morphology on peak cap stress"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1186/1475-925X-10-25](https://doi.org/10.1186/1475-925X-10-25)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1186/1475-925X-10-25](https://doi.org/10.1186/1475-925X-10-25)
- **혈관**: Coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: FEM study with Neo-Hookean constitutive assumptions
- **시편**: Computational plaque models
- **결과**: necrotic core `E = 1 kPa`, equivalent `C10 = 0.167 kPa`
- **특이사항**: (1) Loree 1994를 very soft core의 근거로 가장 직접적으로 재사용하는 later FEM paper. (2) Neo-Hookean form으로 옮겨갔지만 soft-core 해석은 여전히 low-kPa order를 유지함.
### 2.11 Tang et al. 2009
---
**"Sites of Rupture in Human Atherosclerotic Carotid Plaques Are Associated With High Structural Stresses"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1161/STROKEAHA.109.558676](https://doi.org/10.1161/STROKEAHA.109.558676)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1161/STROKEAHA.109.558676](https://doi.org/10.1161/STROKEAHA.109.558676)
- **혈관**: Carotid plaque, later often discussed with coronary modeling literature
- **실험 방법**: MRI-based FSI computational analysis
- **시편**: In vivo MRI-derived carotid plaque models
- **결과**: updated Tang lipid parameter set `c1 = 2.0 kPa`, `D1 = 2.0 kPa`, `D2 = 1.5`
- **특이사항**: (1) Tang 2004보다 stiffer한 updated assumption set. (2) 이 값은 실험 root가 아니라 Tang-group의 later modeling update임.
### 2.12 Kelly-Arnold et al. 2013
---
**"Revised microcalcification hypothesis for fibrous cap rupture in human coronary arteries"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1308814110](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1308814110)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1308814110](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1308814110)
- **혈관**: Human coronary plaque model
- **실험 방법**: High-resolution microcalcification-based computational stress analysis
- **시편**: Computational coronary cap models informed by imaging
- **결과**: lipid core `E = 5 kPa`
- **특이사항**: (1) immediate sources는 Ohayon 2008과 Akyildiz 2011. (2) 그러나 5 kPa 자체가 original experimental root는 아니며, later modeling choice로 보는 것이 적절함. (3) deeper background는 Cheng 1993 / Loree 1994 계열에 닿아 있음.
### 2.13 Cilla et al. 2012
---
**"3D computational parametric analysis of eccentric atheroma plaque: influence of axial and circumferential residual stresses"**
DOI: [https://doi.org/10.1007/s10237-011-0369-0](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10237-011-0369-0)
Full text: [https://doi.org/10.1007/s10237-011-0369-0](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10237-011-0369-0)
- **혈관**: Iliac plaque model
- **실험 방법**: 3D computational parametric analysis with modified Mooney-Rivlin material law
- **시편**: 100 idealized computational plaque models
- **결과**: lipid parameter set `c1 = 0.5 kPa`, `D1 = 0.5 kPa`, `D2 = 0.5`

I found several relevant results on coronary plaque biomechanics and fluid-structure interaction (FSI) analyses. Here's what the research literature shows:

## Young's Modulus Values for Necrotic Lipid Core

The lipid core has been modeled as an isotropic, almost incompressible elastic material with Young's modulus (Ecore) values of 5, 25, and 50 kPa, and in another FSI study, the lipid pool was assumed to be linear elastic with a Young's modulus of 50 kPa. These values fall well within your specified 100 kPa range.

## FSI Sensitivity Analysis Context

Fluid-structure interaction (FSI) models have been used to study the effect of a lipid pool on stress/strain distributions in stenotic arteries. Research has demonstrated that peak cap stress amplitude—a biomechanical predictor of plaque rupture—varies exponentially not only with cap thickness, but also with Young's modulus of the necrotic core, highlighting the importance of sensitivity analyses on this material property.

## Clinical Stress Measurements

For context on stress outcomes in these analyses, in ruptured lesions, maximal stress within fibrous cap was significantly higher (174 ± 67 kPa) compared to non-ruptured plaques (52 ± 42 kPa).

The search results indicate that sensitivity analyses on necrotic lipid core Young's modulus are important for understanding coronary plaque vulnerability, and the typical material values used are indeed in the lower kPa range well below 100 kPa.

확인했습니다. **상한 100 kPa는 실험 anchor가 있습니다** — Finet의 parametric 말고 **Teng 2014 실측값**으로 받치면 됩니다.

Teng 2014 **Table 2** verbatim (확정):
> lipid incremental Young's modulus **E(λ=1.0) = 104.4 kPa [31.6, 270.0]**, E(λ=1.1)=220.7, E(λ=1.15)=533.4 kPa

즉 상한 100 kPa ≈ **실측 lipid modulus 104.4 kPa**(생리적 baseline λ=1.0)와 거의 일치합니다. parametric sweep(Finet)이 아니라 **uniaxial 인장 실험값**이라 훨씬 강합니다. (참고로 web 검색상 대부분 FEM은 5–50 kPa를 쓰고, 100 kPa는 lipid의 stiff/organized end — Teng 실측이 정확히 거기 위치.)

Notion 섹션 11의 상한 행을 Finet → **Teng 2014**로 교체하겠습니다.

完了했습니다. Notion 섹션 11 (Lipid-core modulus)의 상한 행을 **Finet 2004(parametric) → Teng 2014(실측)** 으로 교체했습니다.

| Bound | Reference | 값 |
|---|---|---|
| 하한 1 kPa | Cheng 1993 | lipid pool E=1 kPa (soft-core 원전) |
| 하한 보조 | Rezvani-Sharif 2019 | human coronary E=2.7±1.8 kPa (AFM direct) |
| **상한 100 kPa** | **Teng 2014** ✅ | **E(λ=1.0)=104.4 kPa** [31.6–270.0] (실측 인장) |

이제 lipid core [1, 100 kPa]는 양 bound 모두 근거가 있습니다:
- **하한 1 kPa** ← Cheng 1993 (모델 원전) + Rezvani 2019 (관상동맥 직접측정 2.7 kPa)
- **상한 100 kPa** ← **Teng 2014 실측 lipid modulus 104.4 kPa** (parametric 아님)

정직하게 한 가지: Teng 2014는 **carotid(경동맥)** 조직이라 관상동맥과 직접 비교엔 주의가 필요합니다(당신 노트에도 적혀 있던 caveat). 다만 lipid core를 분리해 인장한 실험 자체가 드물어서, 100 kPa 상한의 **실측 근거로는 현재 가장 강한 단일 출처**입니다. Finet(parametric)·Perez(training range 1–100)는 참고로 quote에 같이 적어뒀습니다.

다음 진행은? (남은 hemodynamic의 ΔP·τ 분포 보강 / 또는 지금까지 새로 찾은 문헌들 일괄 references.bib 등록)
